successCriteria.description: All four flagged files (auth-context.tsx, auth.service.ts, auth.service.test.ts) import api-client symbols exclusively through the public entry point web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts — no deep imports into api-client.ts, api-error.ts, or token-storage.ts.
The only dependency edge introduced by these imports is auth -> api-client, matching the committed frontend dependency map; no auth -> infrastructure or other uncommitted edge is created.
The dependency-direction gate reports zero findings for files under web/src/modules/auth after the change.

constraints: The four imports must continue to resolve to web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts (the api-client public entry point); no import path may be rewritten to a deep file (api-client.ts, api-error.ts, token-storage.ts).
No runtime behavior change to the auth module: login/logout/session semantics, token storage, and 401 handling must remain byte-for-byte identical.

The api-client module must remain at web/src/infrastructure/api with its public entry point re-exporting IApiClient, ApiClient, ApiError, TokenStorage, and ITokenStorage; no relocation or new shared module is introduced.
outOfScope: No relocation of the api-client module out of web/src/infrastructure/api, and no creation of a new shared module to host the api-client symbols.
No change to the backend dependency map or to any file under src/ (the backend auth module is unaffected).
No behavioral refactor of the auth module (login/logout/session/401 handling) beyond resolving the false-positive dependency finding.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The auth -> api-client dependency edge must match the committed frontend dependency map (auth -> api-client, shared-types), not the backend 'Authentication and read endpoints (v3)' map.

The api-client module boundary and its public entry point (web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts re-exporting IApiClient, ApiClient, ApiError, TokenStorage, ITokenStorage) must match the reconciled architecture's api-client module definition.
